source.spec: Planned-skills inventory 2026-11-10: the EU Cyber Resilience Act had zero coverage in the library while Article 14 reporting has applied since 11 September 2026; no existing skill classified CRA products, ran the reporting clock or checked an SBOM against Annex I Part II(1)
